title: Save command output to a file and display it
summary: Use tee to save the output of a command to a file while still showing it on your screen. This is useful for keeping a record of what a command did without losing the visual feedback.

aliases.text: save output to file and screen
сохранить вывод в файл и на экран

steps.explain: Pipe the output of a command to tee, specifying the file where you want to save the output. The output will appear on your screen and be written to the file.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the file where the output will be saved

alternatives.explain: Use the --append flag to add the output to the end of an existing file instead of overwriting it.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the file to append to
